records.key: Add a row that keeps only the objects whose measurement -- area, mean intensity, solidity or any other scalar region property -- falls between a minimum and a maximum. Fill in the column of every object it should apply to; a blank cell leaves that object unfiltered. Default no filters.

records.translation: Bæta við línu sem heldur aðeins hlutum þar sem mælingin (flatarmál, meðalstyrkur, þéttleiki eða einhver annar kvarðaður svæðiseiginleiki) er á milli lágmarks og hámarks. Fylltu út dálk hvers hlutar sem hún á við; autt hólf lætur þann hlut ósíaðan. Sjálfgefið engar síur.

records.key: Assign the selected images to channel {n}.

records.translation: Úthluta völdu myndunum til rásar {n}.

records.key: Choose the plate folder in src to read the segmentation QC its mask run wrote.
records.source: Choose the plate folder in src to read the segmentation QC its mask run wrote.
records.translation: Veldu plötumöppuna í src til að lesa bútunar-QC sem grímukeyrsla hennar skrifaði.

records.key: Click to open the segmentation QC the mask run wrote for this plate: the verdict, the wells it flags and the likely cause. It is advisory and never stops Measure from running.
records.source: Click to open the segmentation QC the mask run wrote for this plate: the verdict, the wells it flags and the likely cause. It is advisory and never stops Measure from running.
records.translation: Smelltu til að opna bútunar-QC sem grímukeyrslan skrifaði fyrir þessa plötu: niðurstöðuna, brunnana sem hún merkir og líklega orsök. Hún er aðeins til ráðgjafar og stöðvar aldrei Measure.

records.key: Copied {n} image(s) into {output}; the mapping is in {manifest}.
records.source: Copied {n} image(s) into {output}; the mapping is in {manifest}.
records.translation: Afritaði {n} mynd(ir) í {output}; vörpunin er í {manifest}.

records.key: Detect sets needs at least two channels: assign images to channels first, by selection or with a chanID group.
records.source: Detect sets needs at least two channels: assign images to channels first, by selection or with a chanID group.
records.translation: Finna mengi þarf að minnsta kosti tvær rásir: úthlutaðu fyrst myndum til rása, með vali eða með chanID-hóp.

records.key: Find a regex that puts every image in exactly one complete set: the token that changes with the channel, and the tokens that name the field.
records.source: Find a regex that puts every image in exactly one complete set: the token that changes with the channel, and the tokens that name the field.
records.translation: Finna regex sem setur hverja mynd í nákvæmlega eitt heilt mengi: hlutann sem breytist með rásinni og hlutana sem nefna sjónsviðið.

records.key: Ignore the names' structure: pair each image with the most similar image of the same size in every other channel, then show three sets to check.
records.source: Ignore the names' structure: pair each image with the most similar image of the same size in every other channel, then show three sets to check.
records.translation: Hunsa uppbyggingu nafnanna: para hverja mynd við líkustu mynd af sömu stærð í hverri hinna rásanna og sýna síðan þrjú mengi til að athuga.

records.key: Make the text in this column's panels larger or smaller. The setting is remembered. Default 100%.
records.source: Make the text in this column's panels larger or smaller. The setting is remembered. Default 100%.
records.translation: Stækka eða minnka textann í reitum þessa dálks. Stillingin er munuð. Sjálfgefið 100%.

records.source: Moved {moved} file(s); {stacks} stack(s) and {merged} merged array(s) written under {dest}. Every move is in {manifest}.
records.translation: Færði {moved} skrá(r); {stacks} stafli/staflar og {merged} sameinuð fylki skrifuð undir {dest}. Hver flutningur er í {manifest}.

records.key: Pretrained {epochs} epochs (last loss {loss:.3f}). The checkpoint is chosen in the Foundation model picker; press Embed to use it.
records.source: Pretrained {epochs} epochs (last loss {loss:.3f}). The checkpoint is chosen in the Foundation model picker; press Embed to use it.
records.translation: Forþjálfað í {epochs} lotur (síðasta tap {loss:.3f}). Vistunarpunkturinn er valinn í vali grunnlíkana; ýttu á Ívefja til að nota hann.

records.key: Published results: Krull, Buchholz and Jug, 'Noise2Void - learning denoising from single noisy images', CVPR 2019; Hock et al., 'N2V2 - fixing Noise2Void checkerboard artifacts with modified sampling strategies and a tweaked network architecture', ECCV 2022 workshops. spaCR has not scored it on its own data.
records.source: Published results: Krull, Buchholz and Jug, 'Noise2Void - learning denoising from single noisy images', CVPR 2019; Hock et al., 'N2V2 - fixing Noise2Void checkerboard artifacts with modified sampling strategies and a tweaked network architecture', ECCV 2022 workshops. spaCR has not scored it on its own data.
records.translation: Birtar niðurstöður: Krull, Buchholz og Jug, 'Noise2Void - learning denoising from single noisy images', CVPR 2019; Hock et al., 'N2V2 - fixing Noise2Void checkerboard artifacts with modified sampling strategies and a tweaked network architecture', ECCV 2022 workshops. spaCR hefur ekki skorað það á eigin gögnum.

records.key: Select images and assign them to a channel, or let a regex assign every image. On Apply the images and their masks are MOVED into one folder per channel under {dest}, renamed in Yokogawa format, and merged into merged/. Every move is written to a manifest.
records.source: Select images and assign them to a channel, or let a regex assign every image. On Apply the images and their masks are MOVED into one folder per channel under {dest}, renamed in Yokogawa format, and merged into merged/. Every move is written to a manifest.
records.translation: Veldu myndir og úthlutaðu þeim til rásar, eða láttu regex úthluta hverri mynd. Við Beita eru myndirnar og grímur þeirra FÆRÐAR í eina möppu á rás undir {dest}, endurnefndar á Yokogawa-sniði og sameinaðar í merged/. Hver flutningur er skrifaður í yfirlitsskrá.

records.key: Self-supervised (DINO) pretraining of a ResNet-18 on the loaded crops, no labels needed, under the chosen channel policy. Choose a checkpoint file; it is saved after every epoch, and choosing the same file again resumes the run. When it finishes the checkpoint is offered in the Foundation model picker. Slow without a GPU. Default 20 epochs from random weights at 64 px.
records.source: Self-supervised (DINO) pretraining of a ResNet-18 on the loaded crops, no labels needed, under the chosen channel policy. Choose a checkpoint file; it is saved after every epoch, and choosing the same file again resumes the run. When it finishes the checkpoint is offered in the Foundation model picker. Slow without a GPU. Default 20 epochs from random weights at 64 px.
records.translation: Sjálfstýrð (DINO) forþjálfun ResNet-18 á hlöðnu úrklippunum, án merkja, samkvæmt valinni rásastefnu. Veldu vistunarpunktsskrá; hún er vistuð eftir hverja lotu, og að velja sömu skrá aftur heldur keyrslunni áfram. Þegar henni lýkur er vistunarpunkturinn boðinn í vali grunnlíkana. Hægt án GPU. Sjálfgefið 20 lotur frá slembivægjum við 64 px.

records.key: Self-supervised denoising: CAREamics trains a Noise2Void (N2V2) network on a run's own noisy fields, with no clean images, and Make Masks denoises every segmentation channel with it before the enhancement chain. Training wants a GPU; a CPU trains a small model slowly. PyTorch is held below 2.12 and torchvision at 0.26 or older, the newest pair CAREamics 0.3.4 accepts.
records.source: Self-supervised denoising: CAREamics trains a Noise2Void (N2V2) network on a run's own noisy fields, with no clean images, and Make Masks denoises every segmentation channel with it before the enhancement chain. Training wants a GPU; a CPU trains a small model slowly. PyTorch is held below 2.12 and torchvision at 0.26 or older, the newest pair CAREamics 0.3.4 accepts.
records.translation: Sjálfstýrð suðhreinsun: CAREamics þjálfar Noise2Void-net (N2V2) á eigin suðugum sjónsviðum keyrslu, án hreinna mynda, og Make Masks hreinsar suð úr hverri bútunarrás með því á undan bætingarkeðjunni. Þjálfun krefst GPU; CPU þjálfar lítið líkan hægt. PyTorch er haldið undir 2.12 og torchvision á 0.26 eða eldra, nýjasta parinu sem CAREamics 0.3.4 samþykkir.
